title: Replay — Browser Automation Platform
description: Visual browser automation platform with a ReactFlow canvas, Browserbase-powered headless execution, live session replay via HLS, and real-time collaborative workflows via Liveblocks.
longDescription: Replay is a browser automation platform built around a visual workflow canvas (ReactFlow). Users compose automation workflows by connecting nodes on the canvas — each node maps to a browser action (navigate, click, fill, extract). Workflows execute against Browserbase headless browsers with Stagehand for AI-assisted interactions. Sessions are fully observable via HLS replay streams. Liveblocks enables real-time multiplayer on the canvas. Background tasks run via Trigger.dev with a registry-driven node executor pattern.
features: Visual workflow canvas powered by ReactFlow with registry-driven node system
Browserbase headless browser execution with Stagehand AI-assistance
Session replay via HLS playlist — full browser recording observability
Real-time collaborative canvas with Liveblocks multiplayer
Trigger.dev background job execution for long-running automations
Neon PostgreSQL + Drizzle ORM with schema-derived types
Clerk authentication with Next.js App Router
challenges: Registry-driven node executor pattern — missing executor is a compile error
HLS session replay proxied server-side to protect Browserbase API keys
Real-time multiplayer canvas state sync via Liveblocks
Drizzle schema as single source of truth for all database types
impact: Currently in active development
Zero-code browser automation via visual canvas
Full session observability with replay playback
Multiplayer workflow collaboration

title: Clinical MCP Server
description: Self-describing MCP server that gives AI agents a bank of clinical and business intake questions, with intelligent question routing based on case context.
longDescription: Built an intelligent, self-describing MCP server using the Model Context Protocol SDK that provides AI agents with dynamic clinical and business intake question banks.
